source_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS agendaItemId,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,a.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber
FROM AgendaItem AS a
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO AS b ON b.dst_id=a.node_id
JOIN Summary AS s ON s.node_id=b.src_id
JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT AS p ON p.src_id=s.node_id
JOIN Meeting AS m ON m.node_id=p.dst_id
WHERE s.summaryType='FL' AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM rel_MODERATED_BY AS role JOIN Company AS company ON company.node_id=role.dst_id
 WHERE role.src_id=s.node_id AND company.companyName='Huawei'
)
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,a.agendaNumber ASC,a.id ASC;
